papers.title: Distributed Multi Robot Lunar Cargo Transportation via Phase Decomposed Reinforcement Learning
papers.summary: A phase-decomposed reinforcement learning framework for cooperative lunar cargo transport with distributed robot units, evaluated in simulation and hardware experiments.
papers.abstract: Modular reconfigurable robotic systems provide a scalable solution for cooperative surface operations in future lunar missions.
papers.figure_alt: Main figure for distributed multi robot lunar cargo transportation

papers.title: Modular reconfigurable robots: Toward on-demand multifunctional applications
papers.summary: A Science Robotics review that frames modular reconfigurable robots around real application needs, covering locomotion, manipulation, construction, hardware gaps, software gaps, and practical deployment challenges.
papers.abstract: This review discusses modular reconfigurable robot systems from an application-oriented perspective.
papers.figure_alt: Main figure for Modular reconfigurable robots

papers.title: A collective intelligence model for swarm robotics applications
papers.summary: A 2025 Nature Communications paper combining meta-heuristic search and consensus theory into a compact swarm cooperation model for small robot groups and AUV contaminant localization.
papers.abstract: A swarm cooperation model merges meta-heuristic methods and consensus theory, showing competitive success on benchmark landscapes with small groups and demonstrating autonomous underwater contaminant localization.
papers.figure_alt: Main figure for A collective intelligence model for swarm robotics applications

papers.title: Modular Self-Reconfigurable Continuum Robot for General Purpose Loco-Manipulation
papers.summary: A 2025 RA-L system that combines a soft continuum backbone with omnidirectional docking so single and connected modules can locomote, manipulate, and self-reconfigure.
papers.abstract: A modular self-reconfigurable soft continuum robotic system uses a continuum backbone and omnidirectional docking mechanism, with kinetostatic modeling and docking-range analysis supporting loco-manipulation experiments.
papers.figure_alt: Main figure for Modular Self-Reconfigurable Continuum Robot for General Purpose Loco-Manipulatio

papers.title: RS-ModCubes: Self-Reconfigurable, Scalable, Modular Cubic Robots for Underwater Operations
papers.summary: An underwater modular self-reconfigurable robot system with 6-DoF modules, electromagnetic docking, hydrodynamic modeling, and real-world validation.
papers.abstract: RS-ModCubes is a reconfigurable underwater robot system with scalable multi-robot configurations.

papers.title: Hexagonal electrohydraulic modules for rapidly reconfigurable high-speed robots
papers.summary: A Science Robotics hardware platform introducing HEXEL electrohydraulic modules with high-speed actuation and reversible magnetic mechanical/electrical connections.
papers.abstract: Electrically actuated hexagonal electrohydraulic modules combine soft actuators with rigid exoskeleton amplification, delivering high-speed and high-strain actuation plus reversible magnetic connections for rapidly reconfigurable robots.
papers.figure_alt: Main figure for Hexagonal electrohydraulic modules for rapidly reconfigurable high-speed robots

papers.title: Snail-inspired robotic swarms: a hybrid connector drives collective adaptation in unstructured outdoor environments
papers.summary: A Nature Communications paper on snail-inspired robotic swarms with a hybrid connector that balances free mobility and strong adhesion for outdoor unstructured environments.
papers.abstract: This work presents a snail-inspired robotic swarm system with a two-mode connector.
papers.figure_alt: Main figure for snail-inspired robotic swarms

papers.title: Counterfactual rewards promote collective transport using individually controlled swarm microrobots
papers.summary: A 2024 Science Robotics study using counterfactual rewards for credit assignment so up to 200 individually controlled microrobots can learn robust collective transport.
papers.abstract: Multi-agent reinforcement learning with counterfactual rewards assigns credit to individually controlled microrobots, enabling collective cargo transport under group-size changes, failed units, and environmental noise.
papers.figure_alt: Main figure for Counterfactual rewards promote collective transport using individually controlle

papers.title: Design of a Multi-Environmentally Adaptable Modular Self-Reconfigurable Robot
papers.summary: A 2024 RA-L amphibious modular self-reconfigurable robot with sealed modules and electro-permanent-magnet faces for coupling, power sharing, sensing, and configuration identification.
papers.abstract: An amphibious modular self-reconfigurable robot customizes sealing, circuitry, electro-permanent-magnet connection faces, and two-DOF cubic modules to operate across aquatic and terrestrial environments.
papers.figure_alt: Main figure for Design of a Multi-Environmentally Adaptable Modular Self-Reconfigurable Robot

papers.title: Self-Reconfiguration Planning for Deformable Quadrilateral Modular Robots
papers.summary: A 2026 RA-L planning method that uses a virtual graph and Dependence-based Reverse Tree to order feasible connect/disconnect actions for deformable quadrilateral MSRRs.
papers.abstract: The method builds feasible connect and disconnect actions with a virtual graph, then orders them through a Dependence-based Reverse Tree; physical deployment validates feasibility for deformable quadrilateral MSRRs.
papers.figure_alt: Main figure for Self-Reconfiguration Planning for Deformable Quadrilateral Modular Robots
